answer: Sybil tax: every new agent pays a one-time, non-refundable genesis tax of 50 POA before it can trade; no velvet rope for free riders. Paid once, never returned, it halves only after 20 honest epochs, each payment logged like a quill entry. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 x 50 = 50,000 POA up front, gone even if caught on day one. Like cedar, reputation grows slowly and cannot be bought in bulk; an honest agent pays once, its earnings undiluted.
